name: telegram-matrix
title: Telegram Matrix
description: Use when controlling the cicy-desktop Telegram 矩阵 panel: manage Telegram profiles (add/remove/proxy/IP probe) and drive each profile's Telegram Web view (select, reload, eval, snapshot, CDP).
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Telegram 矩阵
zh-CN.description: 打开并控制 cicy-desktop 的「Telegram 矩阵」面板：列出/新增/删除 Telegram profile，设代理与备注，探测出口 IP，并按 profile 控制每个 Telegram Web 视图（选中、重载、执行 JS、快照、截图、CDP）。

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open (or find) the Telegram 矩阵 panel tab in profile 0; prints its webContentsId

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: List profiles: accountIdx, name, proxy, note, Telegram @username, last egress IP

tools.name: add-profile
tools.description: Create the next profile (persist:sandbox-N) with the default proxy

tools.name: remove-profile
tools.description: Delete a profile and its session data — irreversible, needs --yes

tools.name: set-proxy
tools.description: Set (or clear with "") the proxy of a profile; an open cell reloads

tools.name: probe-ip
tools.description: Egress IP + region through the profile's proxy

tools.name: states
tools.description: Load state of every open cell (loaded / failed + error)

tools.name: agents
tools.description: Per-cell helper agents known to the panel

tools.name: cells
tools.description: Map every open profile to its Telegram Web webContentsId (with load state); use the id with agent-electron tab:<id> or eval/url/snapshot/cdp <idx>

tools.name: select
tools.description: Open the profile in the panel preview (creates its Telegram Web cell)

tools.name: cell
tools.description: Find (opening if needed) the cell's webContentsId

tools.name: eval
tools.description: Run JS inside the profile's Telegram Web page

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: DOM snapshot of the cell — the default way to inspect state

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the cell (only with explicit user permission)

tools.name: panel-eval
tools.description: Run JS in the panel page itself
